messages.subject: Residual Variance Estimation
parts:
Dear Phil,

I ran two models:

1 an IRT model with user-supplied item parameters
2 a latent regression model (the same IRT part with the same user-supplied item parameters + a weak covariate).

However, I got larger residual variance (estimated COV_11 of the second model) than the total variance  (estimated COV_11 of the first model).

I wonder did the estimate of COV_11 include a correction of df in the denominator (i.e. was the number of covariates included in the denominator)?

Thank you in advance!
Dihao

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Residual Variance Estimation
parts:
Hi Dihao,

There's no df correction in this case as the estimates are all maximum-likelihood by default. So you're correct that they may be a little more optimistic than they should be, and in the case of weakly informative covariates could indeed increase given the increase in sampling variability (it only asymptotically decreases with the sample size). HTH.

Phil
